entries.title: Psalms 70:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. To bring to remembrance.>> Make [haste], O God, to deliver me! Make haste to help me, O LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 70:2
segments: Let them be ashamed and confounded Who seek my life; Let them be turned back and confused Who desire my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 70:3
segments: Let them be turned back because of their shame, Who say, "Aha, aha!"

entries.title: Psalms 70:4
segments: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; And let those who love Your salvation say continually, "Let God be magnified!"

entries.title: Psalms 70:5
segments: But I [am] poor and needy; Make haste to me, O God! You [are] my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
